name: Fiona
source:
The main character of Reborn in Sin. After angering her creator, Fiona was cast to the mortal realm. 

Everything about mortal life is new to her—even things like eating. 

Proud but naive, she often forgets that she’s fallen from grace. This results in many humorous and awkward encounters.

She’s the type of innocent that some people would just love to corrupt...
